name: San Francisco
description: A region pack: San Francisco, crude first (playtest 1c). Steep blocks with crest jumps, cable cars as slow traffic, painted row houses, fog, and the approach to a big orange bridge. It reuses the base game's bikes, weapons, regular rivals and traffic.

meta.notes: Playtest 1c, 2026-09-30: "Pnw and sf first then others". Every name, line and number here is a placeholder within the tone guide that the maintainer can veto.
